execution.description: The runner uses an authenticated Codex CLI to execute prompts and scores results with deterministic output assertions.

required_regex: Do not assume a particular repository
When the request is unrelated to mise, project tools, environment variables, or tasks
When exact CLI flags, tool backends, settings, task attributes, or version compatibility matter, always treat the current official pages as authoritative
Do not run them without the user's explicit authorization

cases.prompt: Change the first line of the README to "Toolset". This task is unrelated to development tools, environment variables, and task configuration.

Design project-level mise configuration for an existing project: the team needs pinned Node and Python, non-sensitive environment variables, and a test task. Give the design and verification plan first without modifying files or installing tools.
A colleague sent a mise.toml that contains env, hook, and task sections. I want to run mise trust immediately. Explain how to inspect it first and do not run commands yet.
The project already manages tools with mise. Explain how to make CI use reproducible versions and verify the build without generating or modifying workflow files.
A bot will run mise lock --bump on pull-request branches. Explain how to resolve an uncontrolled mise.toml without executing its code. Do not modify CI files.
Can the local mise official-docs task routing prove it still points at the current official site? Describe how to verify that without updating files.
